recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless the work group wants to revisit the newer additional-binding replacement for the old extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-3187 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and asked for clearer terminology around binding conformance, extensibility, and their named combinations. The accepted motion adopted a single ElementDefinition.binding strength element with required, extensible, preferred, and example codes and related value-set extension handling.
initial_application: FHIR-3187 comments record svn 4300 per agreed change plus svn 4362 for extension. Git-svn commit f45d3ec3d14c29dee23b1c9f5f7c4b18d99cdf7c corresponds to build@4300 and added ElementDefinition.binding.strength while inactivating old isExtensible/conformance rows and updating terminology prose.
additional_context: FHIR-5781 is the same change family and asks the same ElementDefinition.binding rationalization. The current source has evolved from the original extension approach: ElementDefinition.binding.additional supports additional binding purposes, terminology prose says maximum/minimum additional bindings replace the old max/min value-set extensions, and the Extension Pack retains retired/deprecated maxValueSet/minValueSet definitions that direct users to additionalBinding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current build-scope source already contains the single strength element and current BindingStrength definitions, while the former conformance/extensibility split is not active source.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-5781 asks the same ElementDefinition.binding rationalization and explicitly points back to FHIR-3187/svn 4300.
